contentSummary: This is an extremely thin two-statement page: a Vision sentence ("To emerge as leaders in the ship recycling business and to spearhead unprecedented heights, providing safety to our people and the environment and delivering superior value to all stakeholders.") and a Mission sentence pair ("Our mission is to set global standards for safety and environment protection and raise the bar for others to follow. In all our activities, we strive to fulfill this mission."). Total body copy is roughly 60 words, sitting in a col-md-8 column beside a col-md-4 blog-style sidebar carrying an "Our Companies" link list and a static "Contact Us" address block. The only other content is a full-width ISO…
